meta.name: Classical · total cost · radius dependent
meta.metric: Parameterized total time bound in n and decoding radius
meta.regime: Exact BDD on arbitrary Euclidean lattices; decoding radius is specified per result and preprocessing is included
meta.rules: For the radius alpha stated by each entry, return the nearest lattice point for targets satisfying dist(t,L) ≤ alpha lambda_1(L). Count every preprocessing and advice-construction step in total time. Do not rank bounds for different radii as a common numerical leaderboard. Keep supplied-basis, unbounded-preprocessing query and polynomial-advice models separate.
